_readme: Your own ModOrder rules. Copy this file to <D2RMM>\modorder-userlist.json and edit it. Same format as masterlist.json: an entry with the ids of a mod the masterlist knows adds to it (lists are appended, single values such as group replace it); an entry for another mod is new. Delete the examples you do not want.

after.why: it places its dungeon after the conversions' levels
I want my density, not Rebirth's
